overview: A personal loan tracking app that lets you record loans you give to others, track repayments, and automatically calculate outstanding balances. Features status tracking (active, completed, overdue) with a full repayment history per loan.
features: Create loans with borrower name, amount, due date, and notes
Track individual repayments with dates and notes
Auto-calculated pending amounts and loan status
Loan detail view with full repayment history
Dashboard with all loans and their current status
